book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: QꞌU KAM IBꞌAXABꞌSA IKꞌUCHAXU TIOXH TU U XHAN (Apocalipsis) U uꞌuj uvaꞌ Apocalipsis uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun

content: Ni til u Xhun isotz u Babilonia
As tul bꞌaꞌnxi, as kat vil ikuꞌ chꞌuꞌl umaꞌt u ángel tu almikaꞌ. As mamaꞌla chit iyakꞌil atike. As yak chit itxiju u vatz txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ u ángel tuul iviꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ:

content.text: ¡Kat sotzyu veꞌteꞌ; kat sotzyu veꞌt u nimla Babilonia!
Tan tatinbꞌal veꞌt unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ kat ibꞌanlu veꞌteꞌ,
tan aꞌ nimolkat veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ skajayil.
As ech veꞌt u Babilonia echeꞌ isok unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla chaj tzꞌikineꞌ,
tan kajayil chit unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ kat ibꞌan veꞌt tetz echeꞌ u vaꞌlexheꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌan u Babilonia.
As kat paavin veꞌt unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ skajayil kꞌatz u Babilonia uvaꞌ ech tatineꞌ echeꞌ umaj ixoj uvaꞌ yanaꞌs.
As kat bꞌen veꞌt unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ stxꞌiol iqꞌiil taꞌn u tachaꞌv u Babilonia, tiꞌk u ángel tala.

content: As kat vabꞌi umaꞌt u tuul viꞌ tu almikaꞌ uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ ex untenam, as elojtaj chꞌuꞌl ex tu u Babilonia,
aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la paavin ex echeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan u Babilonia.
As yeꞌ la potzan ex taꞌn u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uveꞌ tul stiꞌ,
tan mamaꞌla veꞌt ipaav u Babilonia kat ibꞌanlu vatz u Tiixheꞌ.
As yeꞌ la sotz veꞌt vipaaveꞌ skꞌuꞌl u Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ at tu almikaꞌ.
As la aqꞌpu veꞌt ichꞌexel ste, choobꞌal tetz u vaꞌlexheꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As kaꞌpul la aqꞌpu ichꞌexel ste tiꞌ jununil unqꞌa vaꞌlexheꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As bꞌanaoj tuch vichꞌexeleꞌ uvaꞌ la aqꞌpu ste echeꞌ kaꞌvoꞌj nimla picheel ukꞌaꞌ
uvaꞌ vaꞌl chit ikꞌayal echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat taqꞌ u Babilonia te unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As kat ijeꞌsa tibꞌ u Babilonia. As kat toksa jeꞌ iqꞌii tiꞌ unqꞌa tetzeꞌ uvaꞌ jeꞌnal chit ijaꞌmil.
Estiꞌeꞌ la ul veꞌt u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ stiꞌ,
tan ech ni tal jeꞌ ileꞌ ste:
«As xonleꞌl veꞌt in tzitzaꞌ echeꞌ ixonebꞌ umaj tixqel umaj bꞌooqꞌol tenam tu vibꞌaꞌnla xonlebꞌaleꞌ.
As yeꞌxh jatu la bꞌuchlu veꞌt in, tan echeꞌ in koj txakay ixoj,» tiꞌk u Babilonia tal jeꞌ ste.

content: Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tu kuxh umaꞌl qꞌii as la ul veꞌt unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ tiꞌ u Babilonia

content.text: echeꞌ u kamchileꞌ, tukꞌ oqꞌeleꞌ tukꞌ ikuypu vaꞌy.
As la tzꞌeꞌ veꞌteꞌ taꞌn xamal, tan at iyakꞌil u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌanon isuuchil u Babilonia.

content: As jankꞌal unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat paavin kꞌatz u ixojeꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ kam uvaꞌ ni tachva vichiꞌoleꞌ, as la oqꞌ veꞌteꞌ taꞌn txumuꞌm, tul la til veꞌt ijeꞌ visibꞌil u Babilonia.
As tul la til veꞌt tul u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ tiꞌ u Babilonia, as la ijetzꞌ veꞌt el tibꞌ skꞌatz taꞌn xoꞌvichil. As la mox taqꞌ jeꞌ tuul iviꞌ. Ech la tal veꞌt ileꞌ:

content.text: ¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz! ¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz u nimla tenameꞌ uvaꞌ Babilonia!
Tan aꞌeꞌ u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chit talpeꞌ.
As tu kuxh umaꞌl oora kat ul u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ stiꞌ,

content: As echat la ibꞌan unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ skajayil vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tan la oqꞌ veꞌteꞌ taꞌn txumuꞌm, tul la til u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uvaꞌ la ul tiꞌ u nimla tenameꞌ, tan yeꞌxhebꞌil ati uvaꞌ la loqꞌon veꞌt vikꞌaꞌyeꞌ

echeꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla qꞌan chꞌichꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla saj chꞌichꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj kꞌubꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj kueentaxheꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj oksaꞌmeꞌ, tan atik unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla nuꞌkin ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ uvaꞌ kaj tukꞌ muraꞌt tiloneꞌ. As atik unqꞌa kꞌaꞌyeꞌ uvaꞌ txꞌumtxꞌulla chaj tzeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj aqꞌonbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ marfil ibꞌii, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj tzeꞌ uvaꞌ jeꞌnal ijaꞌmil, tukꞌ unqꞌa sula qꞌan chꞌichꞌeꞌ. As atik u aqꞌonbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ chꞌichꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla kꞌubꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ marmol ibꞌii.

As atik unqꞌa kꞌaꞌyeꞌ uvaꞌ kanela, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa txꞌumtxꞌulla tzeꞌ uvaꞌ nikuꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa echbꞌubꞌaleꞌ, tukꞌ incienso, tukꞌ unqꞌa txꞌumtxꞌulla tzꞌakabꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ mirra ibꞌii, tukꞌ vino, tukꞌ aceite, tukꞌ harina, tukꞌ trigo, tukꞌ unqꞌa txokopeꞌ tetz ijatz, tukꞌ unqꞌa kaneeroꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa kaayeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa kareꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ qinimal taꞌn unqꞌa kaayeꞌ, as tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌayimal veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ tok skꞌamil.

As ech la tal veꞌt unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌy ileꞌ tiꞌ u tenameꞌ: —As kat sotzyu veꞌt u chiꞌla chaj vatz tzeꞌeꞌ uveꞌ achvebꞌal chit see. As yeꞌxh jatueꞌ la eel veꞌt unqꞌa txꞌiibꞌal aqꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ nik atꞌeꞌsi eebꞌ stukꞌ,— chaj veꞌt unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ la taleꞌ.

As jankꞌal unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ uvaꞌ nik ikꞌayineꞌ as kat ok veꞌt stxꞌiol iqꞌiil taꞌn vikꞌaꞌyeꞌ tu u Babilonia, as la ijetzꞌ veꞌt el tibꞌ skꞌatz taꞌn xoꞌvichil, tul la til veꞌt u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tul tiꞌ u nimla tenameꞌ. As la mox oqꞌ veꞌteꞌ taꞌn txumuꞌm. As la taqꞌ jeꞌ tuul iviꞌ.

content.text: ¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz! ¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz u nimla tenameꞌ uvaꞌ Babilonia!
Tan bꞌaꞌnla nuꞌkinla oksaꞌm uveꞌ nik toksa, tan xolel chiteꞌ unqꞌa toksaꞌmeꞌ tukꞌ muraꞌt tukꞌ kaj.
As vejelik tibꞌ taꞌn unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla qꞌan chꞌichꞌeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla kueentaxheꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌnla kꞌubꞌ chittuꞌ.
As tu kuxh umaꞌl oora as kat sotz veꞌt unqꞌa txꞌiibꞌal iqꞌiieꞌ skajayil,

content: chaj veꞌt unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ. As jankꞌal unqꞌa olin tetz unqꞌa barco, tukꞌ unqꞌa aqꞌonvileꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ atoꞌk tu unqꞌa barco uvaꞌ nixaan viꞌ u mar, as tukꞌ unqꞌa u vaaꞌ ni taqꞌonveꞌ tiꞌ itxeyat unqꞌa txayeꞌ xeꞌ u mar, as la ijetzꞌ veꞌt el tibꞌ kꞌatz u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uvaꞌ nik tul tiꞌ u tenameꞌ.
As tul la til veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ nijeꞌ veꞌt isibꞌil u tenameꞌ tul nik itzꞌeꞌeꞌ, as la sikꞌin veꞌteꞌ. As ech la tal veꞌt ileꞌ: —Yeꞌl umaꞌtoj tenam la lejon tiꞌ u nimla tenameꞌ,— chaj la taleꞌ.
As mamaꞌla txumuꞌm la ok veꞌt xeꞌ taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ atik viꞌ u mar. As saqꞌchibꞌal chit veꞌt toqꞌeꞌ. As ech la mox tal veꞌt ileꞌ:

content.text: «¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz! ¡Oyebꞌ chit ivatz u nimla tenameꞌ!
Tan tukꞌ u txꞌiibꞌal iqꞌii u nimla tenameꞌ, as ok veꞌt unqꞌa ibꞌaal unqꞌa barco stxꞌiol iqꞌiil.
As tu kuxh umaꞌl oora as kat sotz veꞌt u nimla tenameꞌ,» chaj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ at viꞌ u mar.
¡As jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ echen ex tu almikaꞌ, as chiibꞌojtaj ex
tiꞌ uveꞌ kat ibꞌanlu u nimla tenameꞌ!
¡As txuqꞌtxunojtaj ex, ex apóstol tukꞌ ex qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ as tukꞌ ex uvaꞌ ex itenam u Tiixheꞌ sekajayil,
tan tul kat taqꞌ tzan Aak u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ tiꞌ u Babilonia, as ichꞌexel kat ibꞌan Aak ste tiꞌ u vaꞌlexh uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u tenameꞌ sete! tiꞌk u tuul viꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ vabꞌi.

content: As umaꞌt u ángel uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chit iyakꞌil, as kat ixek veꞌt umaꞌl u nimla kꞌubꞌ echeꞌ umaj kaꞌ. As kat isuti veꞌt bꞌen xeꞌ u mar. As ech tal veꞌt u ángel ileꞌ:

content.text: As axh u nimla tenameꞌ uvaꞌ Babilonia,
as ech asotzeꞌ tukꞌ yakꞌil echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ulbꞌel u nimla kꞌubꞌeꞌ,
tan techal la sotz veꞌt evatz vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
As yeꞌl unpajtoj la abꞌil iqꞌoop u arpa sexoꞌl. As mitaꞌn u suꞌeꞌ; as mitaꞌn u trompeta.
As yeꞌ veꞌt aqꞌon la bꞌanchu veꞌt sexoꞌl.
As yeꞌl unpajtoj la abꞌil veꞌt icheꞌel u chanaleꞌ vatz u kaꞌeꞌ.
As yeꞌl unpajtoj la ilax veꞌt itxijun umaj xamal sexoꞌl.
As mitaꞌn la abꞌil veꞌt ichiibꞌ umaj chelem naj tukꞌ umaj qꞌopo ixoj tul la teqꞌo tibꞌ.
As ech tuk ibꞌaneꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaꞌtoj tenam vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ la lejon tiꞌ unqꞌa aakꞌaꞌyeꞌ uveꞌ at sexoꞌl,
tan tukꞌ unqꞌa etxumbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa bꞌanol txꞌiꞌlaꞌmileꞌ as kat eyansa itxumbꞌal unqꞌa nimla tenameꞌ skajayil.
As sexoꞌl kat elkat vikajal unqꞌa niman tetz u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol Aakeꞌ
as tukꞌ unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil uvaꞌ kat yatzꞌpu veꞌteꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tiꞌk u ángel uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chittuꞌ.
